meta.name: Brain Donors
meta.description: Three manic idiots—a lawyer, a cab driver and a handyman—team up to run a ballet company to fulfil the will of a millionaire. Stooge-like antics result as the trio try to outwit the rich widow and her scheming big-shot lawyer, who also wants to run the ballet.
meta.slogan: Three bozos. One ballet company. Tutu many laughs!
